description: Text normalization parity fixtures (AQ-02 P2a and P2b). scripts/tests/test_language_metrics.py and Tests/VocelloCoreTests/WordErrorRateTests.swift both score every case under the current normalization (v3) and must reproduce `expected` exactly. `primaryErrors` is the gated edit count: the segmentation-aware word distance, or the character edits for Chinese, Japanese and Korean. `pythonDiagnostics` never gate and are Python-only. A `P2b` case needs a step beyond P2a (its `slot` in language_metrics.NORMALIZATION_EXTENSION_SLOTS): a slot the current normalization fills pins its score in `expected`, and a Chinese case the Traditional-to-Simplified fold changes also pins its normalization v2 count in `expectedV2` (records that declare normalization-v2-edit-rate-v3 rescore under v2); an open slot pins today's score and `expectedAfterP2b` what its step will change. Cases whose id starts with `sweep-` are generated by `python3 scripts/tests/test_language_metrics.py --write-sweep-cases`: every code point of its SWEEP_BLOCKS, 64 to a case, in the folded (English), compatibility (Japanese) and Hangul (Korean) profiles, against its NFD spelling, so Swift's stdlib and Foundation Unicode data answer to Python's code point by code point; and every entry of the Chinese fold table (`sweep-chinese-fold-`), 64 to a case, its Traditional sources against its Simplified targets, so the Swift copy of the table answers to Python's entry by entry.
